title: Next.js on Windows is facing an immediate RCE threat.
content_md:
Public exploit code for CVE-2026-75604 appeared shortly after disclosure, putting Windows-hosted Next.js applications that process untrusted input at serious risk. Framework-level RCEs are rapidly automated—patch immediately. submitted by /u/thechougala [link] [comments]
